hotel.name: Luxury Hotel Tirana
hotel.slogan: Ku Luksi Takon Elegancën e Përjetshme
hotel.description: Në zemër të Bllokut në Tiranë, Luxury Hotel ofron një përvojë luksi të pakrahasueshme. Me komoditete të klasit botëror, kuzhinë të shkëlqyer dhe pamje mahnitëse, çdo moment bëhet një kujtim i çmuar. Angazhimi ynë për përsosmëri siguron që çdo mysafir të marrë shërbim të personalizuar të standardit më të lartë.
hotel.address: Rruga Ismail Qemali, Blloku, Tiranë, Shqipëri

rooms.name: Single Room
rooms.description: A cozy and elegantly designed room perfect for solo travelers. Features a plush single bed, marble bathroom, and city views.

rooms.name: Double Room
rooms.description: Spacious and luxurious with a king-size bed, premium linens, and panoramic windows offering stunning city skyline views.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: An opulent retreat featuring premium furnishings, a separate living area, rain shower, and breathtaking garden views.

rooms.name: Family Suite
rooms.description: The perfect family getaway with two bedrooms, a spacious living room, kids' corner, and all the comforts of home in a luxury setting.

rooms.name: Presidential Suite
rooms.description: The pinnacle of luxury — a sprawling suite with private terrace, jacuzzi, butler service, and panoramic 360° views of the city.

services.name: Luxury Spa
services.description: Indulge in our world-class spa treatments, from hot stone massages to rejuvenating facials.

services.name: Infinity Pool
services.description: Relax by our stunning rooftop infinity pool with panoramic views of the city skyline.

services.name: Airport Transfer
services.description: Enjoy seamless luxury airport transfers in our premium Mercedes fleet.

services.name: Gourmet Breakfast
services.description: Start your day with our international breakfast buffet featuring local and continental cuisine.

services.name: 24/7 Room Service
services.description: Our dedicated team is available around the clock to cater to your every need.

services.name: Laundry & Dry Clean
services.description: Premium laundry and dry cleaning services with same-day delivery available.

services.name: Conference Room
services.description: State-of-the-art conference facilities for meetings, events, and corporate gatherings.

services.name: Fitness Center
services.description: A fully equipped gym with personal trainers, yoga classes, and modern equipment.

testimonials.name: Elena Krasniqi
testimonials.comment: An absolutely magical experience! The Presidential Suite exceeded all our expectations. The staff was incredibly attentive and made our anniversary celebration truly unforgettable.

testimonials.name: Marco Berisha
testimonials.comment: World-class service and breathtaking views. The spa treatments were divine, and the restaurant served the finest cuisine I've ever tasted. Will definitely return!

testimonials.name: Sophie Laurent
testimonials.comment: Stunning hotel with impeccable design. The infinity pool at sunset is a must-experience. The Deluxe Room was spacious, modern, and incredibly comfortable.

testimonials.name: David Hoxha
testimonials.comment: From the moment we stepped in, we were treated like royalty. The concierge arranged everything perfectly. This is the gold standard of hospitality.

testimonials.name: Isabella Gashi
testimonials.comment: Our family suite was perfect for our vacation. The kids loved the pool, and we enjoyed the spa. The breakfast buffet had something for everyone!
